gaps.description: Cross-validation results report only accuracy metric; per-class metrics (precision, recall, F1) are missing. Chicago TDD Rank-2 domain contract: classification quality requires more than aggregate accuracy.
gaps.current_behavior: stratifiedKFold() returns per-fold accuracy scores only. No per-class breakdown available for imbalanced datasets.
gaps.recommendation: Extend KFoldResult interface to include per-class metrics: { accuracy, precision_per_class: Map<class, number>, recall_per_class, f1_per_class, confusion_matrix }. Compute from fold-level predictions.
gaps.impact: Users cannot detect class-specific degradation (e.g., minority class accuracy low despite high overall accuracy). Regression risk on imbalanced data.

gaps.description: Zero-variance and multicollinear features are detected but not automatically removed. Recommendations are text-only; no mechanism to filter feature matrix in-place.
gaps.current_behavior: assessFeatureQuality() detects { zeroVarianceColumns: 3, correlatedPairs: [{col1, col2, correlation}] } and warns. Caller must manually inspect and decide.
gaps.recommendation: Add optional removeProblematicFeatures(matrix, quality_report, strategy) function with strategies: 'none', 'zero_variance_only', 'zero_and_correlated'. Return { matrix_cleaned, columns_removed, impact_summary }.
gaps.impact: Noisy features degrade model quality; users with high correlation must manually engineer. Automation missing.
affected_code: ml-runner.ts:454-470 (quality check, then proceed without remediation)

gaps.description: Algorithm selector uses heuristics (log size, feature count, variance) but does not validate recommendations empirically against baseline performance data. No grid search or hyperparameter sensitivity analysis.
gaps.current_behavior: suggestAlgorithm() returns { method: 'knn', confidence: 0.75, rationale: '...' } based on log characteristics. Confidence is heuristic-derived, not empirically calibrated.
gaps.recommendation: Add optional calibration step: Run recommendation on a curated benchmark set (algorithm-baselines.json fixture). Measure actual accuracy improvement vs. default method. Recalibrate confidence thresholds annually.
gaps.impact: Recommendations may be overconfident on new data distributions. No feedback loop to improve selector over time.
affected_code: packages/testing/fixtures/algorithm-baselines.json (exists but not used in selector evaluation)

gaps.description: Parameter suggestion functions use hardcoded heuristics (e.g., suggestClusteringK() = sqrt(n/2)) without sensitivity analysis or hyperparameter search. No mechanism to tune k, epsilon, or other critical parameters per dataset.
gaps.current_behavior: suggestClusteringK() returns fixed formula refined by log characteristics. No grid search (k=2..10 with silhouette scoring).
gaps.recommendation: Add optional gridSearchClusteringK(data, range=[2,10], metric='silhouette') function. Score each k via silhouette or Davies-Bouldin index. Return { best_k, scores_per_k, elbow_point }. Integrate into ml-runner with flag --tune-k.
gaps.impact: Users get fixed default k; suboptimal clustering on logs with different structure. High-variance datasets need adaptive k selection.
affected_code: ml-runner.ts:360-380 (cluster task dispatch with no tuning flag)

gaps.description: Feature scaling recommendations (StandardScaler vs MinMaxScaler) are made per-algorithm but not validated for actual impact. BASELINE_ACCURACY_IMPROVEMENT hardcoded empirical data may not apply to user logs.
gaps.current_behavior: suggestScalingForAlgorithm() returns scaling recommendation based on algorithm type. Empirical improvement baseline is fixed (e.g., 'knn': 0.12). No per-domain calibration.
gaps.recommendation: Add optional validation: Run recommended scaling on sample (10% of training data), measure actual improvement vs. no scaling. Return { suggested_scaling, predicted_improvement: 0.12, actual_improvement: 0.08, delta: -0.04 } with confidence adjustment.
gaps.impact: Feature scaling recommendations may not transfer to new domains. Users cannot verify prediction before committing to scaling.
affected_code: ml-runner.ts:420-450 (no validation of scaling impact before applying)

gaps.description: AutoML envelope extracts 5 features (event_density, activity_diversity, trace_length_variance, rework_ratio, concept_drift_indicator) but feature values have unbounded ranges. event_density can be [0, ∞), while others normalized to [0,1]. No feature importance ranking; which features drive anomaly scoring?
gaps.current_behavior: extract_motion_features() returns raw feature values with mixed scales. risk_score = sum of scaled features. No transparency on which features dominate anomaly decisions.
gaps.recommendation: Normalize all features to [0,1] after extraction (min-max scaling per feature over training set). Add feature_importance: Map<feature_name, weight> to AutomlEnvelopeModel. Log which features triggered 'anomalous' verdict.
gaps.impact: Feature interpretation difficult; users cannot understand why traces marked anomalous. Risk score lacks statistical grounding.

summary: 6 gaps identified across ML pipeline. 4 MEDIUM severity (per-class metrics missing, automatic feature removal, hyperparameter tuning, parameter suggestions hardcoded), 2 LOW severity (selector validation, feature scaling validation, automl transparency). All gaps have actionable recommendations. Most critical: G-ML-001 (classification metrics) and G-ML-004 (hyperparameter search) directly impact model quality assessment and reproducibility.
iteration_context: Iteration 5 AutoML Audit gaps (G1-G4) have been substantially remediated. Current gaps (G-ML-001 to G-ML-006) are refinements and enhancements beyond the core implementation.
chicago_tdd_impact: G-ML-001 violates Rank-2 domain contract (classification quality requires per-class metrics for imbalanced datasets). G-ML-004 blocks Rank-1 oracle for hyperparameter optimization (grid search is foundational to ML validation).
recommended_priority: LOW: G-ML-003, G-ML-005, G-ML-006 (empirical validation and transparency enhancements)
